description: Ranniku üleujutusalad is a dataset listed in Data information gateway, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Keskkonnaagentuur. Map layer of flood areas. Coverage: Keskkonnaagentuur. The portal shows the English title as "Coastal flood areas" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Keskkonnaagentuur. Its keywords include rannikualad, üleujutusalad, floods, üleujutused, coastal regions, flooded areas. The listing shows 2 download or service links in HTML. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-avaandmete-portaal.
